title: Feature Flag Dependency Validation
objective: Memastikan kombinasi flag aman dan dependency tidak menghasilkan state tidak valid.

default_matrix.description: All 13 v1.2 flags default to OFF when registry is fresh.

dependency_matrix.description: No cross-flag dependencies in v1.2 wave-1; each flag is independent.

enable_disable.description: Individual flags can be enabled and disabled independently.

kill_switch.description: Emergency kill-switch forces all flags OFF and blocks isEnabled until disengage or explicit re-enable.

state_preservation.description: Registry state can be projected to and restored from an override store.

graceful_fallback.description: Unknown flags throw ArgumentError; missing override file returns clean defaults.

limits: No cross-feature dependency graph in v1.2 wave-1 (all flags independent)
Override persistence validated at domain level, not wired to settings UI yet
Kill-switch interaction with live project sessions not in scope
decision: Local automated validation only; native GUI, hosted CI, signing, hardware, public release DEFERRED
